newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI shortlists Autostrade sale advisers.
newsitem.headline: IRI shortlists Autostrade sale advisers.

text.p: Italian industrial holding IRI said on Thursday it had drawn up a short-list of 12 groups to select advisors for the privatisation of its motorway operator unit Autostrade.
IRI launched the search for a global consultant and evaluator for the sell-off last month.
Six of the groups are Italian and six are foreign, IRI board members Antonio Urciuoli and Piero Gnudi told reoprters on their way out of a board meeting. They gave no further details.
Autostrade chairman Giancarlo Elia Valori said last month the sell-off should be handled in such a way that the group does not falli into "untrustworthy hands".
IRI wants to sell off Autostrade by the end of this year, but a regulatory authority for the transport sector, a necessary pre-privatisation step, has yet to be created.
Financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore on Thursday quoted IRI president Michele Tedeschi as saying he believed the sell-off could go ahead "even without the (regulatory) authority".
